verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS risk platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents any setting to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The only related material describes Sardine's SDK collecting device and behavioral signals for fraud detection, which is a product function and not a user opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
